g.text: Terms: MAVLink = Micro Air Vehicle Link, the PX4 telemetry and command protocol · MAVSDK = MAVLink software development kit · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source
flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · ROS = Robot Operating System (ROS 2) · SITL = software-in-the-loop simulation · SSF-nnn = safety-significant software
function record (safety/software/) · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SysML = Systems Modeling Language (SysML v2) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
